DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious Asthma (Cough-variant Asthma)

Based on your history of a recent upper respiratory infection followed by a persistent cough that worsens at night and with exertion, these are classic triggers for asthma. I need to confirm if you experience wheezing, chest tightness, or shortness of breath between episodes. Have you noticed any seasonal patterns or exposure to dust/pet dander? REQUEST TEST: Pulmonary_Function_Tests (Spirometry with Methacholine Challenge). REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
